# ADR-3022: A02: Prefer forward secrecy cipher suites for mesh 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Static RSA key exchange weakens past-session secrecy.

## Decision

Service meshes SHOULD prefer forward secrecy cipher suites for mesh 10 (A02-10) where protocol support allows.

## Consequences

Cipher inventory is reviewed quarterly.
